alkylation_concentration: Then, the samples were alkylated by adding 10 mM iodacetamide.
alkylation_reagent: Then, the samples were alkylated by adding 10 mM iodacetamide.
cleavage_agent: After incubating in the dark for 30 min, the samples were digested with trypsin (protein: trypsin = 100:1) at pH 8–9 and 37 °C overnight.
collision_energy: The 20 most intensive ions were fragmented with 28% normalized collision energy, and tandem mass spectra were acquired with a mass resolution of 17,500 at m/z 200.
enrichment_method: The enrichment of Kbz peptides was carried out as described previously. Briefly, the peptides were incubated with pre-balanced pan anti-Kbz antibody-conjugated beads or pan-Kbz antibody at 4 °C with gentle shaking.
instrument: The eluted peptides were analyzed by a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) using a nanospray source.
ionization_type: The eluted peptides were analyzed by a Q Exactive mass spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific, San Jose, CA) using a nanospray source.
ptm: The following parameters were used during sequence alignment: methionine oxidation, protein N-terminal acetylation, lysine acetylation, lysine mono-/di-/tri-methylation, arginine mono-/di-methylation, and lysine benzoylation were specified as variable modifications.
reduction_concentration: Whole-cell proteins and histone samples were reduced by adding 5 mM TCEP and incubated for 30 min at room temperature.
reduction_reagent: Whole-cell proteins and histone samples were reduced by adding 5 mM TCEP and incubated for 30 min at room temperature.
